description: Six native-eight-second standing-action migrations. All source, physical and visual review remain pending; source timing and solver anchors are preserved.
reviewPolicy: External actual visual review bound to source and preview manifest/index/PNG SHA is required before full production. No automatic review approval.

phase.countingSemantics: One descent, gentle bottom pry and return to the half squat counts as one rep; 8 seconds contains two bilateral demonstration reps. Preserve the existing 3 reps with 10 seconds held per rep, but the actual source plateau is only 1.4 seconds per rep. The clip does not implement a 10-second hold; prescription/playback reconciliation requires editorial approval.

risks: Inspect prayer-hand/finger contact, elbow/knee/thigh overlap, heel contact and groin/torso volume at both deep peaks.
Legacy default holdSeconds=10 differs from the actual 1.4-second plateau. Do not silently retime the source or represent the demo as a 10-second hold.

phase.countingSemantics: Preserve the legacy rep_cycle interpretation: one complete circle in each direction is one 8-second rep cycle. Default reps=4 means four two-direction cycles (four circles per direction), not four single circles or four per-side leg reps. Direction reverses at 4 seconds; feet remain planted throughout. The 0–0.6 and 7.4–8 second amplitude ramps overlap the angular phases.

side.note: Pelvis first travels forward then towards body left; direction reverses near 4 seconds. Both feet support the body throughout; no working-leg switch.

risks: Inspect palms and fingers on both hip surfaces through the complete circle and reverse circle; the existing touch solver is retained.
Inspect planted feet and knee stability with pelvic translation/tilt; the amplitude ramp overlaps the angular phase, so early frames are not a static hold.

phase.countingSemantics: One shift towards one side and return to centre counts as one rep. The 8-second clip shifts left then right, for two total alternating reps; default reps=8 means eight total shifts (four per direction), not eight per side. Both feet remain planted and legacy unilateral=false is retained for bilateral-supported weight-transfer control.

side.note: Both feet stay planted; first load shift is towards the left foot, then towards the right at 4 seconds. This is a direction change within bilateral-supported movement, not a single-leg demonstration.

risks: Inspect prayer-hand/finger contact and deep torso/thigh/knee overlap at both lateral peaks; both heels must remain planted.
The source remains low throughout; do not label the return-to-centre phase as standing up.

phase.countingSemantics: One lateral squat and return led by one loaded leg counts as one rep. The 8-second clip demonstrates one right-loaded then one left-loaded rep. Preserve FlareLab prescription: default reps=5 is per side (five full loops give five reps on each side), not five total alternating reps. Switch loaded leg at 4 seconds.

side.note: First squat loads the right leg and straightens/raises toes of the left; after 4 seconds the left leg loads and right leg straightens. Highlight remains both.

risks: Inspect both loaded-leg peaks, straight-leg knee reach >=176 degrees and arms/elbows >=174 degrees on the new mesh.
Heel-roll contact is deliberate: the straight leg toes rise and only its heel stays grounded; do not require a whole-foot pin on that side.
The source stillAt=0 is neutral; use the explicit batch semantic peak. Inspect solver continuity and frame 239-to-0 seam.

phase.countingSemantics: One hinge and return on the supporting leg counts as one rep. Default reps=8 is per side, as explicitly prescribed in the legacy FlareLab record. The 8-second clip shows two left-support reps, with the right leg lifted behind, and no side change. Complete four loops for the default left-side dose before an optional external change; opposite-side media is not produced.

side.note: Only the left support/working leg is demonstrated; the right leg lifts behind. Eight seconds is an available loop-boundary cue after the prescribed per-side dose, not an encoded or mandatory every-loop switch.

risks: Inspect planted left-foot contact and support knee >=160 degrees, lifted right knee >=176 degrees near hinge>0.6, pelvis balance and actual finger clearance.
New-model arm length may affect the authored near-straight hanging-arm path; do not alter the source solver silently. Highlight remains both sides despite left-support-only motion.

phase.countingSemantics: One right-leg raise and controlled lowering counts as one rep. The 8-second clip contains two right-leg reps with left-foot support and no side change. Keep default reps=12; proposed interpretation is 12 per working side (six loops), but legacy metadata does not explicitly state per-side versus total and editorial confirmation is required. Do not switch sides automatically every loop or generate mirrored media.

side.note: Right leg abducts while the left leg supports throughout. Eight seconds is an optional external boundary after the prescribed per-side dose, not a switch encoded in the clip.

risks: Inspect visible hand/finger contact on both hips, support foot stability, both knees >=172 degrees and pelvis balance through both raises.
Confirm right-leg-only highlight and suspended moving-foot rest; do not demand a moving-foot floor pin. Default 12-rep per-side interpretation remains editorial pending.
